story.title: Give No Quarter
story.blurb: Odran and the Ravens' leader sit in the dark after a bruising defeat, puzzled by Sascha's survival and determined to hunt down the crew that beat them.

lines.text: The wide halls echoed with the sounds of electronic beeping and heavy footsteps. Despite their recent successful attack, the Ravens did not bother celebrating. There was always something to be done, and after the last few weeks of being on GU News every night, it seemed optimal to keep the momentum. However, the two remaining Ravens did not party nor toil. They sat in silent darkness on their small warship, biding their time.

Odran’s eyes stayed glued to the glowing holovision, rewinding the same clip over and over. It was hard to believe what he was seeing. He had seen many things during his time with the insurgent group, but this—this was puzzling, and it nearly made Odran nauseous.

“The footage you are seeing is of today’s terrorist attack on the Fort Gallite GU Military Base, where Major Bobed Ustrrot, notable for his war developments, was killed. It is believed that this was organized by the infamous terrorist group, the Ravens. No other casualties have been confirmed, largely due to an unexpected team of fearless individuals. Though currently unidentified, these heroes rushed into the building and rescued other victims as—”

lines.text: The news report halted as Odran motioned at the HV. “Three GUYs of successful operations. Six GUYs of holding the top ranking in the mafia before. But even with that, she’s defeated by a bunch of pests sent by the galaxy’s greatest propaganda machine,” Odran pondered aloud. He nearly choked when he saw Sascha on the news the day before. Not in a million years could Odran have anticipated this outcome.

lines.text: “Nothing new, sir,” said Odran, looking up at the screens overhead. He was not as good as Sascha at deciphering the diagnostics, but he knew what it ultimately meant. “I don’t know how, but their fleet somehow made it out alive, taking Sascha’s body with them! The armor is nowhere to be found, so they must have destroyed it, or she took it off—but why would she do that!? There must be some explanation, I just need—”

lines.text: Odran left the intelligence booth and headed for the armory, with blazing determination in his eyes. This had surely been the final nail in the coffin. If there ever was a time for the Horizoners to redeem themselves, or a chance to obtain forgiveness—it had passed and been forgotten. The crew had twice stood in the way of the Ravens, and they would pay dearly for that mistake.
The Ravens would wreak their vengeance.
And give no quarter.
